TradeTrust Announces Growth & Vendor Onboarding Internship for Surat’s Textile Market

30 Oct 2026, 10:25 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Careers Desk · Source: in.linkedin.com

Key takeaways Overview TradeTrust, an internet marketplace platform focused on connecting textile manufacturers and wholesalers with buyers across India, has posted a **Growth & Vendor Onboarding Intern** position targeting the bustling Ring Road market in Surat, Gujarat. The role

Overview

TradeTrust, an internet marketplace platform focused on connecting textile manufacturers and wholesalers with buyers across India, has posted a Growth & Vendor Onboarding Intern position targeting the bustling Ring Road market in Surat, Gujarat. The role is designed to help digitise local textile suppliers, bringing their collections onto TradeTrust’s online storefronts.

Employer and Platform Context

TradeTrust operates as a B2B e‑commerce facilitator for the Indian textile sector. By aggregating product listings from manufacturers and wholesalers, the platform aims to streamline buyer‑seller interactions and expand market reach for traditionally offline traders. The company’s growth strategy includes on‑ground outreach in key textile hubs such as Surat’s Ring Road market, a dense cluster of fabric manufacturers, wholesalers, and garment makers.

Role Summary

The intern will spend 3–6 months conducting field visits across the Ring Road market buildings, engaging directly with business owners to:

  • Explain TradeTrust’s value proposition and guide suppliers through registration and profile creation.
  • Collect product photographs, specifications, pricing, and availability for digital catalogue entry.
  • Maintain a structured lead list, track onboarding stages, and provide daily market insights to the Growth & Operations and catalog teams.
  • Follow up post‑onboarding to ensure storefronts remain complete and address any issues that arise.

Eligibility Criteria

TradeTrust lists the following minimum qualifications:

  • Education: Currently enrolled or recent graduate in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, Textiles, or a related discipline. Candidates from other fields with strong communication skills and a practical interest are also welcome.
  • Language Skills: Fluent spoken Gujarati and Hindi.
  • Local Knowledge: Familiarity with Surat’s textile trade, especially the Ring Road market, and an understanding of fabric or garment categories.
  • Experience: Prior exposure to B2B sales, field marketing, merchant acquisition, or customer onboarding; experience with e‑commerce platforms, digital catalogues, product photography, or online storefronts is advantageous.
  • Technical Comfort: Ability to use smartphone apps, basic spreadsheets, and lead‑tracking tools.

Compensation

The posting mentions a base stipend plus performance‑based incentives tied to successful supplier onboarding and digitisation. Exact monetary amounts and payout schedules are not specified and will be discussed during the selection process.

Application Details

  • Location: Surat, Gujarat – the intern must be comfortable with regular in‑person visits and walking across the Ring Road market.
  • Application Deadline: Not specified.
  • Selection Process: Not specified.
  • Application Steps: Interested candidates should apply through the LinkedIn job posting at the official URL provided below. The LinkedIn page may require users to sign in or create an account before submitting an application.
  • Official Application Link: https://in.linkedin.com/jobs/view/growth-vendor-onboarding-intern-surat-textile-market-at-tradetrust-4484792454

Practical Implications for Applicants

  • Hands‑On Experience: Interns will gain direct exposure to B2B sales, supplier onboarding, and digital commerce within one of India’s largest textile markets.
  • Skill Development: The role emphasizes field communication, data collection for digital catalogues, and the use of simple CRM‑style tools—skills transferable to broader e‑commerce and sales functions.
  • Network Building: Working closely with TradeTrust’s Growth & Operations and catalog teams, interns can develop relationships with a wide range of textile traders, potentially opening future employment opportunities in the sector.
